answer: An active identity must lease one of 10,000 nontransferable slots for 20 epochs by locking at least 30 credits and paying a 1-credit tax each epoch. The ledger binds each slot to one key; reuse by two keys voids both and burns 60% of the bond. A jade bid may cross a grove to a harbor, but every extra fake needs another slot: 1,000 aliases lock 30,000 credits and pay 1,000 per epoch. Validators verify key mappings and tax receipts on-ledger; three missed taxes suspend the slot for five epochs.
